subject: Startups
title: Session Duration and Frequency
description: A micro-lesson that makes Session Duration and Frequency usable.

hook.text: Do users spend 2 minutes or 20 minutes per session? Do they come back daily or monthly? Both signals matter.

buildup.text: Session duration measures depth. Session frequency measures habit. Together they reveal how much users depend on you.

discovery.text: TikTok's average session is 95 minutes. That's not a tool—it's addictive entertainment with a masterful algorithm.

twist.text: Longer isn't always better. For productivity tools, short frequent sessions mean the tool works efficiently.

climax.text: The ideal pattern depends on your category. Know what 'healthy' looks like for your business and optimize for it.

punchline.text: Depth or frequency—know which one your product needs.

quiz.question: Why might short sessions be positive for a productivity tool?
options: It means the tool helps users accomplish tasks efficiently
The servers can't handle long sessions
